titulo: BG ID 1.18 - Android TV - Search doesn’t work for movies, series, or channels. When pressing OK on the remote, it returns to the app’s home screen.
BG ID 1.19 - Trailers display the YouTube logo and options such as Share and Watch Later.
BG ID 1.20 - The channel categories are too close to the bottom of the screen; it would look better if they were positioned a little further up.
BG ID 1.21 - When moving from the channel category to the channels list, the cursor doesn’t go to the top of the list; it stays where the category was.
BG ID 1.22 - Channels don’t work; several were tested and none played.
BG ID 1.23 - EPG text formatting is broken due to special characters

BG ID 1.24 - When selecting a movie or series and navigating to the content details screen, scrolling to the bottom of the page causes the recommended titles section to be partially overlapped by the native Android navigation buttons (system navigation bar).

BG ID 1.25 -   In the “Resume Watching” section, the remaining time text is displayed with incorrect line breaking. The text appears truncated and split into multiple lines, making it difficult to read and visually inconsistent with the expected layout.

BG ID 1.26 -   In the EPG (Electronic Program Guide) schedule, when a program title is too long, the title text does not wrap correctly. In some cases, the text overflows horizontally; in others, it moves to a second line but part of the text becomes partially hidden or clipped, as shown in the image.

BG ID 1.27 -   In the EPG (Electronic Program Guide), some program titles  and in the discription, are being displayed with incorrect symbols and broken characters, indicating a text encoding issue. Accented characters appear corrupted and unexpected symbols are shown in the title, as illustrated in the image.

BG ID 1.28 -   When the “Autoplay Next Episode” switch is disabled in the settings, the expected behavior is that playback should stop at the end of the current episode. However, even with the switch turned off, the player automatically advances to the next episode once the current one finishes.

BG ID 1.29 -  The player progress bar keeps moving back and forth, and this isn’t necessary for live channels. It gives the user the impression that they can rewind or fast-forward, but that isn’t possible.
